_meta: Weekly-cap calibration anchored to the OFFICIAL Claude usage display (the ground truth for the account's quota — official > any local estimate). The token report's per-record billable methodology (input+output+cache_create, summed per JSONL record) already tracks the official count closely (78% vs official 76% before calibration). This file pins the weekly cap so the report's % EQUALS the official %. Re-anchor whenever the official display drifts from the report: `uv run python scripts/token_report_email.py --calibrate <official_fraction>` (e.g. --calibrate 0.76) recomputes derived_weekly_cap from the current billable.
